prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create an original production sprite sheet of modular beast anatomy for an illuminated manuscript composition editor. Image: 16:9 landscape, target 3840×2160, genuine transparent RGBA background with alpha. Layout: invisible EIGHT COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, exactly THIRTY-TWO isolated cutouts. All cells are identical in size (target 480×540 pixels). Place the center of each object exactly at its cell center. Each complete object must fit inside the inner 72% of cell width and height, leaving broad fully transparent gutters around all four sides. One independent object in each cell. Art may never touch or cross cell boundaries. Do not cluster or arrange objects freely; strict regular equal spacing is essential because the result will be cut at exact equal row and column boundaries.

Style: detailed 14th-century illuminated manuscript marginalia, hand-painted flat gouache with fine brown ink contours and subtle dry pigment texture. Restrained warm burgundy, lapis indigo, sage green, antique gold, warm taupe and ivory. Consistent line weight, stylistic scale and finish across all 32 objects. Modular fantasy creature assembly pieces, charming historical flat perspective. Anatomy pieces are decorative drawn components with clean attachment bases; no blood, injury or flesh interiors.

Follow this exact row-major subject order, left to right in each row:
ROW 1: Column 1: Burgundy dragon head facing left, two small gold horns, clean neck attachment; Column 2: Rust red fox head facing left, cream muzzle, black pointed ears, clean neck attachment; Column 3: Sage gray wolf head facing left, alert pointed ears, clean neck attachment; Column 4: Golden taupe hare head facing left, two long upright ears, clean neck attachment; Column 5: Front facing indigo owl head with round gold eyes, clean neck attachment; Column 6: Warm brown stag head facing left with modest gold antlers, clean neck attachment; Column 7: One detached coiled antique gold ram horn; Column 8: One detached branching golden brown stag antler.
ROW 2: Column 1: Burgundy dragon torso only, horizontal oval tapered chest and abdomen, no head legs tail or wings, clean attachment ends; Column 2: Sage gray furry wolf torso only, horizontal standing silhouette, no head legs or tail, clean attachment ends; Column 3: Golden tawny lion torso only, horizontal standing silhouette, no head legs or tail, clean attachment ends; Column 4: Indigo feathered plump bird torso only, no head legs tail or wings, clean attachment ends; Column 5: One burgundy and gold butterfly wing with fine spot markings; Column 6: One elegant indigo and gold feathered bird wing angled upward; Column 7: One sage and burgundy bat wing with slender gold ribs; Column 8: One ornate blue dragon wing with gold webbing and small burgundy scales at attachment.
ROW 3: Column 1: One golden lion foreleg and rounded paw with neat claws, clean upper attachment; Column 2: One bent golden lion hindleg with broad haunch and paw, clean upper attachment; Column 3: One sage gray furry wolf foreleg with dark paw, clean upper attachment; Column 4: One long folded taupe hare hindleg and long foot, clean upper attachment; Column 5: One golden bird lower leg with three curled talons, clean upper attachment; Column 6: One burgundy scaled short reptile leg ending in three gold claws, clean upper attachment; Column 7: One slender tawny deer foreleg with black split hoof, clean upper attachment; Column 8: One sage green webbed frog foot with short ankle, clean attachment.
ROW 4: Column 1: One long burgundy scaled serpentine tail curled into an S, gold pointed tip; Column 2: One curved fluffy rust fox tail with cream tip; Column 3: One thin golden lion tail with burgundy tuft, graceful curve; Column 4: One slender pink taupe rat tail curled into a spiral; Column 5: One paired set of upright taupe hare ears joined at a small clean base; Column 6: One elongated sage green pointed ear with burgundy inner detail; Column 7: One fan shaped indigo fish fin with golden fine rays; Column 8: One gold and indigo forked fish tail fin with a short scaly attachment base.

Critical output constraints: transparent background, real alpha, no parchment or white rectangle, no painted checkerboard, no shadows, no visible grid lines, no borders, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermarks, no extra objects. Exactly eight objects per row and exactly four rows. Show every silhouette fully, preserve transparent negative space between objects and inside wings/antlers. Do not combine neighboring components.
